title: fix(metadata-protocol): an object draft's verdict names the namespace-prefix refusal its publish gives (#27444)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_

Fixes #27444

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` describes what a draft's `_diagnostics` carries; the namespace-prefix rule itself is unchanged.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:对象草稿的读取诊断(`_diagnostics`)现在会带上包命名空间前缀的拒绝项 `NAMESPACE_PREFIX`,与"全部发布"拒绝时的代码和原话一致。
- 为什么改:之前草稿缺前缀时一直显示"有效",直到发布整批时才被拒、连同其它草稿一起回滚,作者在编辑处看不到问题。
- 风险与回滚:只读诊断多一条错误;草稿保存、发布行为都不变。回滚即还原 `protocol-authoring-gate.ts` 的这一处调用。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts`(`draftPublishVerdict` 末尾新增的前缀判定)、`protocol.ts`(宿主接线一行)、`protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`(新增两例)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`,预期 17/17 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `draftPublishVerdict` (the draft read's publish verdict, folded into `_diagnostics` by `withPublishVerdict`) now asks, for an `object` draft, `objectNamespacePrefixViolation` — the one judge the publish pre-flight (`publishPackageDrafts`), the per-item publish (`promoteDraftForPublish`) and the direct publish-mode save already ask. One check, not a copy: the host is handed the class's own method (`protocol.ts`, host wiring only).
- It judges against the package the draft is staged into (the draft row's `package_id`, the package "Publish all" promotes it under and passes as `request.packageId`). A draft bound to no package, or to a package that declares no namespace, gets nothing — the judge's own skip.
- Finding shape: one `errors[]` entry with `code: 'NAMESPACE_PREFIX'`, `path: 'name'`, and `message` = the exact sentence publish-drafts refuses with (`Object 'qa_formula_pkg_r2' is missing the package namespace prefix. Rename it to 'r2_qa_formula_pkg_r2' (namespace = 'r2').`); `valid: false`. It is listed before the gate's own issues, the order the batch pre-flight reports it in.
- Unchanged: the draft save is still ungated (ADR-0129 D2, #4463 D1) and answers 200 `state: "draft"`; publish-drafts and the per-item publish refuse exactly as before.

## Tests

Two cases in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts`, through the real save, draft read and publish-drafts doors (the #26707 harness):

- an unprefixed object draft in a namespaced package saves 200 `state: draft`; publish-drafts refuses it `outcome: refused` / `NAMESPACE_PREFIX`; its draft read is `valid: false` and its `NAMESPACE_PREFIX` entry's message equals the publish-drafts `error` string, compared in the same test;
- control: a prefixed object draft in the same package reads `{ valid: true }` and publishes.

Red before the fix (`expected true to be false` on `diagnostics.valid`, 1 failed / 16 passed); green after.

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

Mutation: the new call `? this.objectNamespacePrefixViolation(draft.name, draft.packageId)` replaced with `? null` in `protocol-authoring-gate.ts`. The test imports `./protocol.js` from `src/` (relative), so no `dist/` hop is involved.

```
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob c477eabc961a -> ad467a0d1c65
     × saves as a draft, and its read carries the NAMESPACE_PREFIX refusal publish-drafts gives 16ms
AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
      Tests  1 failed | 16 passed (17)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (c477eabc961a) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The per-item publish skips sealed managed content before asking the prefix judge; the draft verdict follows the batch pre-flight instead, which has no such skip. Not measured whether a draft of a sealed managed object can exist at all; noted, not filed.
- No UI change in this PR: the entry rides the same `_diagnostics.errors` the #26707 findings already ride.
